item.title: Running, Voice, and Inspiration: A Thought Precipitation System
item.description: I’ve always felt that you need to set aside time to think. No matter how smart AI gets, someone still has to tell it what’s worth thinking about. The truly good ideas still have to come from your own mind. But when you’re sitting at your computer, information keeps flooding in. It’s rare to have truly quiet time. I’ve been looking for a way to let those scattered thoughts rise to the surface on their own.
